description: This file defines a React component 'InsertTableDialog' used within a web-based text editing application. It provides a UI dialog for inserting a table by specifying the number of rows and columns, and dispatches a command to insert the table into the editor.

methods.name: InsertTableDialog
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a dialog for inserting a table into the editor, allowing the user to specify number of rows and columns.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Confirm button, dispatching the insert table command with specified rows and columns.
